bets.then_what: 10% relative improvement in OTP → paid conversion by 8 February 2027, compared with concurrent control.
bets.so_what: Guided onboarding helps more eligible customers save their goal and confirm a meal plan within 24 hours of OTP completion.
bets.what: A working Mama.ai onboarding MVP covering goal selection, plan information, purchase questions, confirmed plan choice, existing checkout and human handover, with customer-level tracking.
bets.next_step: Verify baseline OTP-to-paid conversion and 24-hour goal-and-plan completion; use them to confirm the bet and tiny-test targets.

bets.then_what:
Increase leads from ~60/day to 100/day.
Increase converted leads from ~119/month to 200/month.
At current value per converted lead, this can add about QAR 145K more revenue per month.
Over 3 months, that is about QAR 434K extra revenue.
That can close around 5.2% of the QAR 8.38M sales gap.
bets.so_what:
Within the first 2 weeks, prove the Lead Engine is moving in the right direction:
- Increase qualified leads from ~60/day to at least 70/day
- Maintain Lead → Paid conversion at ~6.6% or higher
- Track whether Meal Claim → Weekly conversion is moving towards 5%
If lead volume is increasing without conversion dropping, we know the engine is working and can keep scaling towards 100 leads/day.
bets.tiny_test: Launch a meta campaign and measure number of unique visitors, and claim free meal paying the delivery fees QR.15

bets.then_what: Cater to X % of more customers by adding 12 dietary plans and customizable meals and reduce kitchen working hours to 10 hours  for 3000 meals by 31 Jan 2027
bets.so_what: Cooking hours will be reduced to 12 hours while adding more customisation options to the customers and serving up to 8 dietary options.
bets.what: 50 unique dishes broken into components; the kitchen prepares components and plates them as per the reports.This will help customers get dishes as per their preferences. e.g., if the kitchen is preparing biriyani according to the customer's preferences, we can provide chicken, beef, meat, or fish biriyani based on those preferences and check how many dietary plans can accomodate with these 50 dishes
bets.tiny_test: Build 5 pilot dishes to test how many hours can be saved from the kitchen hours, targeting 2 hours per day, how many dishes will be served with similar taste, and serving upto 8 dietary plans
bets.next_step: Build 5 pilot dishes to test how many hours can be saved from the kitchen hours, targeting 2 hours per day, how many dishes will be served with similar taste, and serving upto 12 dietary plans

bets.then_what: Eliminate churn from call fatigue and scale our response sample size from 5–10 to at least 25 by October 30
bets.so_what: Do survey on 3 distinct issues, targeting 50 customers per issue with a 20% response rate goal to validate digital feedback.
bets.what: Feedback Collection Framework + Set Up Moengage for in app feedback collection
bets.tiny_test: a micro-test triggered from backend on a beef meal survey, targeting at least a 20% response rate out of 30 customers.

bets.so_what: Bulk purchase of beef for one month, negotiating for a lower price as we are committing a bulk quantity targeting 2% food cost reduction
